Such choices broke with the European convention, inherited from Renaissance linear perspective, of placing the principal subject at the center of a balanced, deep scene. Degas's off-center dancers, sliced by the frame, and Monet's high horizons suggest that these painters found in ukiyo-e not a style to imitate but a model for rethinking how a picture could be composed.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: European collectors valued Japanese prints mainly for their vivid, flat colors, which Impressionist painters then copied directly in their own canvases.
Hokusai's Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji was the first Japanese print series to reach Paris, where it replaced Renaissance perspective in French art schools.
Degas and Monet rejected Japanese prints as mere curiosities and instead returned to the centered, balanced scenes of Renaissance painting.
Certain European painters drew on Japanese prints less for their surface appeal than for an unconventional approach to arranging a scene, which reshaped their own compositions.
problem.explanation: 지문은 수집가들이 판화를 색채 때문에 좋아한 것과 달리, 드가와 모네는 호쿠사이의 비중심적 구도와 잘린 화면에서 구성 방식을 새로 생각할 모델을 찾았다고 말하므로 D가 정답이다. A는 색채를 좋아한 주체가 수집가라는 점은 맞지만, 화가들이 그 색을 그대로 베꼈다는 내용은 지문의 '모방할 양식이 아니다'라는 진술과 어긋난다. B의 '최초의 시리즈'나 미술학교 교육 대체 이야기는 지문에 나오지 않는다. C는 화가들이 오히려 르네상스식 중심 구도에서 벗어났다는 지문 내용과 정반대이다.
problem.explanationEn: The text contrasts collectors, who liked the prints for their colors, with Degas and Monet, who took Hokusai's off-center, cropped compositions as a model for rethinking how a picture is arranged. That makes D the answer. A is right that collectors admired the colors, but the text says the painters were not imitating a style, so the claim that they copied the colors directly doesn't hold. B makes claims about the "first" series and about art schools that the text never mentions. C gets it backward: the painters moved away from centered Renaissance compositions, not back toward them.

quality.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Ukiyo-e woodblock printing technique and Hokusai's compositional perspective influencing European Impressionist artists

hardJudge.note: 정답 D 검산 완료: 지문의 '수집가는 색채, 화가는 구성 방식'이라는 대조와 마지막 문장의 결론을 정확히 요약. A는 전반부(수집가의 색채 선호)가 맞아 부분 근거를 가지며, C는 '호기심거리'와 '르네상스 구도' 등 지문 어휘를 재활용해 비교 배제가 필요함. B는 지문에 없는 '최초'·'미술학교' 주장으로 가장 쉽게 배제되지만 말은 됨. 사실 관계(1860년대 파리 유입, 호쿠사이 시리즈의 구도, 드가·모네의 자포니즘 영향)는 통상적 미술사 서술과 부합. 두 해설 모두 동일 결론·글자 참조, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 난이도는 대조 파악+결론 문장 연결의 두 단계 판단으로 medium 적합.

advisory.note: A와 C는 일부 근거(수집가의 색채 선호, 진기품으로 보지 않음)를 갖춘 뒤 왜곡되어 비교가 필요하다. B는 근거 없는 내용이라 쉽게 배제된다. D가 다른 선택지보다 길고 지문을 그대로 바꿔 쓴 느낌이 있어 약간 쉬운 편이지만 medium 범위 안이다. 호쿠사이 작품 묘사(거대한 파도, 통 만드는 장인 그림 후지미가하라)는 사실과 맞다.

problem.passage:
To outside observers, the sema ceremony of the Mevlevi order, founded in thirteenth-century Konya by followers of the poet Rumi, often appears to be a performance of endurance: dancers in tall felt hats and white skirts turn for long stretches without apparent dizziness. Yet for the Ottoman-era dervishes who practiced it, the spinning was valued less as a physical feat than as a structured form of prayer. Each element of the ritual carried assigned meaning. The black cloak removed at the start represented the grave and worldly attachment; the right palm, turned upward, received divine grace, while the left, turned downward, passed that grace to the earth. Even the counterclockwise rotation around the heart was understood as aligning the body with the circling of planets and of pilgrims around the Kaaba. Novices trained for a thousand and one days before joining the ceremony, and much of that training concerned not balance but the inner recitation that was meant to accompany every turn.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

Novices trained for a thousand and one days before joining the ceremony, and much of that training concerned not balance but the inner recitation that was meant to accompany every turn.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: Although the Mevlevi ceremony may look like a test of physical stamina, its practitioners regarded the turning as a symbolically ordered act of devotion.
Although the Mevlevi ceremony began as a form of prayer, Ottoman-era dervishes came to value it mainly for the physical skill it displayed.
Although Mevlevi novices trained for a long period, most of their preparation focused on avoiding the dizziness caused by prolonged spinning.
Although the Mevlevi ceremony drew on Rumi's poetry, its gestures were designed chiefly to imitate the movements of planets and pilgrims.
problem.explanation: 지문은 외부인에게는 지구력을 보여주는 공연처럼 보이는 세마 의식이 실제 수행자에게는 각 요소에 의미가 부여된 기도였다고 대조한 뒤, 망토·손바닥·회전 방향의 상징과 내면 암송 훈련으로 이를 뒷받침하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 관계를 뒤집었다. 지문은 수행자들이 신체적 기량보다 기도로서의 가치를 더 중시했다고 말한다. C는 천일 하루의 훈련이라는 세부는 맞지만, 지문은 그 훈련의 대부분이 균형이 아니라 내면 암송에 관한 것이었다고 밝힌다. D는 행성과 순례자의 회전을 언급하지만 이는 여러 상징 중 하나일 뿐이어서 모든 동작의 주된 목적으로 볼 수 없다.
problem.explanationEn: The text contrasts how the sema looks to outsiders, a feat of endurance, with how the dervishes understood it, a structured prayer in which every element had a meaning. It backs this up with the cloak, the palms, the rotation, and the inner recitation, so A is correct. B reverses the relationship: the text says the dervishes valued the spinning less as a physical feat than as prayer. C gets the long training period right, but the text says most of that training concerned inner recitation, not balance. D takes one symbol, the planets and pilgrims, and wrongly treats it as the main purpose of every gesture.

quality.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Sufi whirling dervish ceremony and mystical spinning meditation within Ottoman Mevlevi order spiritual practice

hardJudge.note: 지문의 핵심 구조(외부 인식 vs 수행자의 이해)를 A가 정확히 포착. B는 관계 역전, C·D는 지문의 세부(1001일 훈련, 행성·순례자 회전)를 부분적으로 차용해 비교·정독이 필요한 오답으로 설계됨. 메블레비 교단·코니아·루미·1001일 수련·망토·손바닥 방향·반시계 회전 등 사실관계 모두 타당. 저작권 의심 없음.

advisory.note: 정답 A는 지문의 대조 구조(외부 시선과 수행자의 이해)를 정확히 담고 있다. B는 관계를 뒤집은 오답이고, C는 지문의 세부를 왜곡했으며, D는 여러 상징 중 하나를 과도하게 일반화했다. 오답들이 지문 세부를 부분적으로 활용하고 있어 medium 난이도에 적합하다. 사실관계(코냐, 천일 하루 수련, 오른손은 위·왼손은 아래, 반시계 방향 회전)도 일반적인 설명과 일치한다.

problem.passage:
For centuries, violinists and collectors have claimed that instruments made by Antonio Stradivari in the early 1700s possess a tone no modern maker can match, and many researchers have tried to explain this supposed superiority through the materials he used. One popular hypothesis holds that the spruce for his soundboards grew during a period of unusually cold European winters, producing dense, evenly spaced growth rings that would vibrate with exceptional clarity. Yet when acoustician Claudia Fritz and her colleagues asked experienced soloists to play both old Italian violins and high-quality new ones while wearing modified goggles that hid each instrument's identity, the players could not reliably tell the two groups apart, and several actually preferred a new violin. These results suggest that the celebrated sound of a Stradivarius may owe less to its wood than to the expectations listeners and players bring to it.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
problem.stimulus: For centuries, violinists and collectors have claimed that instruments made by Antonio Stradivari in the early 1700s possess a tone no modern maker can match, and many researchers have tried to explain this supposed superiority through the materials he used. One popular hypothesis holds that the spruce for his soundboards grew during a period of unusually cold European winters, producing dense, evenly spaced growth rings that would vibrate with exceptional clarity. Yet when acoustician Claudia Fritz and her colleagues asked experienced soloists to play both old Italian violins and high-quality new ones while wearing modified goggles that hid each instrument's identity, the players could not reliably tell the two groups apart, and several actually preferred a new violin. These results suggest that the celebrated sound of a Stradivarius may owe less to its wood than to the expectations listeners and players bring to it.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: Although cold winters produced the dense spruce Stradivari used, modern makers have found ways to treat new wood so that it vibrates with the same clarity.
Although Stradivari's violins are widely thought to sound uniquely good because of their materials, a blind test indicates that their reputation may rest largely on players' beliefs.
Although soloists prefer the sound of old Italian violins, a blind test indicates that they cannot explain which features of the wood create that sound.
Although researchers have studied Stradivari's spruce for centuries, a blind test indicates that the density of growth rings matters more than the age of the wood.
problem.explanation: 지문은 스트라디바리우스의 음색이 목재 때문에 뛰어나다는 통념을 소개한 뒤, 눈을 가린 실험에서 연주자들이 옛 악기와 새 악기를 구별하지 못했다는 결과를 들어 명성이 기대감에서 비롯될 수 있다고 결론짓는다. 따라서 B가 정답이다. A는 추운 겨울 가설을 사실로 확정하고 현대의 목재 처리라는 언급되지 않은 내용을 덧붙인다. C는 연주자들이 옛 악기를 선호한다고 하지만, 실험에서는 구별하지 못했고 일부는 오히려 새 악기를 선호했다. D는 지문에서 다루지 않은 나이테 밀도와 목재 나이의 비교를 결론으로 삼는다.
problem.explanationEn: The text first presents the common belief that a Stradivarius sounds superior because of its wood. It then describes a blind test in which soloists couldn't reliably tell old violins from new ones, and it concludes that the instruments' fame may come from expectations. That makes B the answer. A treats the cold-winter hypothesis as proven fact and adds a claim about modern wood treatment that the text never makes. C says soloists prefer old violins, but in the test they couldn't tell the two groups apart, and some actually preferred new ones. D concludes something about ring density versus the age of the wood, and the text never makes that comparison.

quality.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Stradivarius violin acoustic construction and spruce wood selection creating unmatched tonal properties debate

hardJudge.note: 정답 B는 지문의 통념 제시→블라인드 실험→기대감 결론 구조를 정확히 요약함. A는 가설을 사실로 단정하고 미언급 내용(현대 목재 처리)을 추가, C는 '구별 불가·일부 새 악기 선호'와 모순, D는 미언급 비교(나이테 밀도 vs 목재 나이)로 배제됨. Fritz 연구(변형 고글 착용 블라인드 테스트, 새 악기 선호)와 소빙하기 가문비나무 가설 모두 실제 내용과 부합. 한국어·영어 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 자연스러움. 오답 A·C가 지문 일부에 근거해 비교가 필요하고 D도 그럴듯하여 medium 적합.

advisory.note: B는 통념 제시 후 블라인드 테스트로 반박하는 구조를 정확히 요약한다. Fritz의 고글 블라인드 실험은 실제 연구(PNAS 2012/2014)와 맞는다. 오답들은 지문의 요소(추운 겨울 가설, 선호, 나이테)를 재활용해 부분적인 근거가 있다. 다만 B만 'Although'절이 통념을 제대로 반영해 비교적 쉽게 고를 수 있으므로, medium 중에서도 낮은 쪽이다.

problem.passage:
Early Kufic script, used in the first monumental Qur'an manuscripts, was prized for its angular, horizontal letterforms. As the script migrated onto the walls of mosques and shrines in the eleventh and twelfth centuries, however, artisans did not simply copy it from parchment. Instead, they ______ it, stretching vertical strokes into interlacing knots and folding letters into the same star-and-polygon grids that governed the surrounding tilework, so that a single inscription could be read both as sacred text and as geometric ornament.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: Early Kufic script, used in the first monumental Qur'an manuscripts, was prized for its angular, horizontal letterforms. As the script migrated onto the walls of mosques and shrines in the eleventh and twelfth centuries, however, artisans did not simply copy it from parchment. Instead, they ______ it, stretching vertical strokes into interlacing knots and folding letters into the same star-and-polygon grids that governed the surrounding tilework, so that a single inscription could be read both as sacred text and as geometric ornament.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: preserved
simplified
transformed
abandoned
problem.explanation: 지문은 장인들이 쿠픽 서체를 단순히 베끼지 않고 세로획을 늘려 매듭으로 엮고 글자를 기하학 격자에 맞춰 접었다고 설명하므로, 서체의 형태를 크게 바꾸었다는 의미의 C가 정답이다. A는 '단순히 베끼지 않았다'는 대조와 충돌한다. 옛 서체를 이어 쓴다는 점에서 일부 맞아 보이지만 형태 변화를 담지 못한다. B는 변화를 나타내긴 하지만, 매듭을 엮고 격자에 맞추는 작업은 더 복잡하게 만드는 것이라 방향이 반대다. D는 비문이 계속 성스러운 글로 읽혔다는 내용과 모순된다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage says artisans did not simply copy Kufic. Instead, they stretched its strokes into knots and folded its letters into geometric grids, which means they changed its form dramatically, so C is correct. A clashes with the contrast "did not simply copy," even though it might seem to fit because the old script continued to be used. B does suggest change, but adding interlacing knots and grid structures makes the script more elaborate, not simpler, so it points the wrong way. D contradicts the fact that the inscriptions could still be read as sacred text.

quality.seed: arts and humanities nonfiction — Arabic calligraphy Kufic script evolution and sacred geometric patterning in Islamic architectural decoration

hardJudge.note: "did not simply copy… Instead" 대조와 뒤따르는 구체적 변형 묘사(매듭·격자)를 연결해야 C가 확정됨. A는 서체 계승 측면에서, B는 '변화' 측면에서 부분적 근거가 있고 D도 문맥상 말이 되나 '성스러운 글로 읽힘'과 충돌. 쿠픽 서체의 역사적 서술(초기 꾸란 사본, 11~12세기 건축 비문의 매듭형·기하학적 변형)도 사실에 부합. 다만 대조 표지가 명시적이어서 난이도는 medium 하단에 가까움.

advisory.note: 정답 C는 명확함. 오답 A·B는 부분적 근거가 있어 비교가 필요하고, D는 비교적 쉽게 배제됨. 사실관계(장식 쿠픽·매듭 쿠픽의 건축 적용)도 대체로 타당함. medium 수준에 적합하나 'did not simply copy... Instead'라는 단서가 강해 쉬운 쪽에 가까움.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Tuvan throat singing (khöömei) lets a single performer produce two or more pitches at once: a steady low drone and a whistle-like melody of overtones above it.
- Singers create the melody by reshaping the mouth and tongue to amplify selected overtones of the drone.
- In a 2019 study, acoustician Lena Ortiz recorded 24 Tuvan singers and found that the overtone melodies of herders tended, on average, to fall within the frequency range of steppe wind and flowing water.
- Ortiz cautioned that her sample was small and that the pattern suggests, but does not establish, that the style developed by imitating natural sounds.
- A separate 2021 survey by ethnomusicologist Bat-Erdene Dorj found that the number of formal throat-singing schools in Tuva and western Mongolia more than doubled between 2000 and 2020.

The student wants to present Ortiz's finding about the origins of the vocal style with an appropriate degree of confidence. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Tuvan throat singing (khöömei) lets a single performer produce two or more pitches at once: a steady low drone and a whistle-like melody of overtones above it.
- Singers create the melody by reshaping the mouth and tongue to amplify selected overtones of the drone.
- In a 2019 study, acoustician Lena Ortiz recorded 24 Tuvan singers and found that the overtone melodies of herders tended, on average, to fall within the frequency range of steppe wind and flowing water.
- Ortiz cautioned that her sample was small and that the pattern suggests, but does not establish, that the style developed by imitating natural sounds.
- A separate 2021 survey by ethnomusicologist Bat-Erdene Dorj found that the number of formal throat-singing schools in Tuva and western Mongolia more than doubled between 2000 and 2020.
problem.question: The student wants to present Ortiz's finding about the origins of the vocal style with an appropriate degree of confidence. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Ortiz's recordings of 24 singers indicate that herders' overtone melodies tend to fall within the frequency range of wind and water, possibly reflecting an origin in imitating natural sounds.
Ortiz's recordings of 24 singers show that herders' overtone melodies match the frequencies of wind and water, proving that the style originated as an imitation of natural sounds.
Ortiz's recordings of 24 singers suggest that throat singers may perhaps be able to produce more than one pitch at a time, possibly reflecting an origin in imitating natural sounds.
Ortiz's recordings of 24 singers indicate that throat-singing schools tend to have grown in number, possibly reflecting renewed interest in imitating natural sounds.
problem.explanation:
정답 A: Ortiz의 결과는 '평균적으로 경향이 있다'는 통계적 결과이며 기원은 '시사할 뿐 입증하지 않는다'고 했으므로, 'tend to'와 'possibly'로 잠정성을 유지한 A가 적절하다.
B: 경향을 'match', 'proving'으로 확정적으로 과장했다. Ortiz 본인의 경고와 어긋난다.
C: 한 가수가 여러 음을 동시에 낸다는 것은 노트에서 확정적 사실인데 'may perhaps'로 불필요하게 축소했고, Ortiz의 연구 내용도 아니다.
D: 잠정적 어조는 맞지만 학교 수 증가는 Dorj의 2021 조사 내용으로, Ortiz의 연구와 혼동했다.
problem.explanationEn:
A is correct. Ortiz's result is a statistical tendency ("tended, on average"), and she said it suggests, but does not establish, a natural-sound origin. By using "tend to" and "possibly," A keeps that tentative tone.
B is wrong because it overstates the finding. Words like "match" and "proving" contradict Ortiz's own caution.
C is wrong because the notes state as a fact that singers produce two or more pitches at once. C needlessly hedges that fact with "may perhaps," and producing multiple pitches isn't Ortiz's finding anyway.
D is wrong even though its tentative tone fits. The growth in schools comes from Dorj's 2021 survey, so D confuses it with Ortiz's study.

hardJudge.note: 정답 A는 'tended, on average'와 'suggests, but does not establish'를 'tend to'·'possibly'로 정확히 반영. B는 'match/proving'으로 과잉 확정(체크 3), C는 확정 사실(다중 음고 산출)을 'may perhaps'로 과소 확신(체크 4)하면서 Ortiz 연구 내용도 아님, D는 Dorj의 2021 조사를 Ortiz에 오귀속. 해설은 각 선택지의 오류를 정확히 지적하며 모순 없음. 다만 C·D는 내용 불일치로 비교적 쉽게 제거되어 실질적 변별은 A/B의 확실성 수준 판별에 집중됨 — hard 특성 중 claim_certainty_discrimination과 출처 통합(Ortiz vs Dorj)은 요구하나 변별 강도는 중상 수준.

advisory.note: 정답은 맞고 해설도 일관된다. 다만 hard로 보기에는 변별력이 약하다. C와 D는 Ortiz의 발견 내용(주파수 범위)을 아예 다루지 않아 내용만 봐도 바로 지워지고, B는 'proving'이라는 단어 하나로 걸러진다. 결국 확실성 수준을 따질 필요가 있는 선택지는 A와 B뿐이고, 이 둘의 차이도 너무 뚜렷하다. 오답이 내용을 맞게 담으면서 확실성만 미묘하게 어긋나도록 만든 경우(예: 'tend'는 유지하되 기원 주장을 단정하는 선택지)가 없어 전형적인 medium 수준이다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Medieval scribes sometimes wrote brief comments in the margins of the manuscripts they were copying.
- In a ninth-century Irish manuscript now held in St. Gallen, Switzerland, a scribe noted that the parchment was hairy and the ink was thin.
- The Luttrell Psalter, made in England around 1330, contains marginal illustrations of laborers plowing, harvesting, and grinding grain.
- Historians use the Luttrell Psalter's margins as evidence of the farming tools used in fourteenth-century England.
- Historians use complaints like the St. Gallen scribe's as evidence of the physical conditions scribes worked under.

The student wants to show how the two manuscripts shed light on different aspects of medieval life. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Medieval scribes sometimes wrote brief comments in the margins of the manuscripts they were copying.
- In a ninth-century Irish manuscript now held in St. Gallen, Switzerland, a scribe noted that the parchment was hairy and the ink was thin.
- The Luttrell Psalter, made in England around 1330, contains marginal illustrations of laborers plowing, harvesting, and grinding grain.
- Historians use the Luttrell Psalter's margins as evidence of the farming tools used in fourteenth-century England.
- Historians use complaints like the St. Gallen scribe's as evidence of the physical conditions scribes worked under.
problem.question: The student wants to show how the two manuscripts shed light on different aspects of medieval life. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: A ninth-century Irish scribe complained in a manuscript margin that the parchment was hairy and the ink was thin, a remark historians use as evidence of the physical conditions scribes worked under.

Whereas a St. Gallen scribe's grumbling about hairy parchment and thin ink reveals the conditions of the copyist's own work, the plowing and harvesting scenes in the Luttrell Psalter's margins document the tools of fourteenth-century English farming.
Whereas the St. Gallen manuscript was produced in ninth-century Ireland, the Luttrell Psalter was made in England around 1330, roughly five centuries later.

Whereas a St. Gallen scribe's complaint about hairy parchment shows that Irish monasteries often lacked good supplies, the Luttrell Psalter's farming scenes prove that English laborers enjoyed more advanced tools than Irish ones.
problem.explanation: 정답 B: 두 필사본이 각각 서로 다른 생활 측면(필경사의 작업 환경 / 14세기 영국의 농기구)을 보여 준다는 점을 한 문장에 함께 담아 목표를 이룬다. A: St. Gallen 필사본 하나만 다루므로 '두 필사본'을 비교한다는 목표를 절반만 이룬다. C: 두 필사본을 함께 다루긴 하지만 제작 시기와 장소만 비교할 뿐, 각각이 생활의 어떤 측면을 보여 주는지는 말하지 않는다. D: 아일랜드 수도원에 물자가 '자주' 부족했다는 것과 영국 농기구가 아일랜드 것보다 앞섰다는 것은 노트에 없는 내용으로, 근거를 왜곡한다.
problem.explanationEn: B is correct. It covers both manuscripts and says what different part of medieval life each one shows: the St. Gallen scribe's complaint shows the conditions copyists worked under, and the Luttrell Psalter's scenes show the farming tools of fourteenth-century England. A only talks about the St. Gallen manuscript, so it gets just half of the goal. C mentions both manuscripts, but it only compares when and where they were made. It never says which part of daily life each one reveals. D adds claims that aren't in the notes: that Irish monasteries often lacked supplies, and that English farm tools were better than Irish ones. Those additions misrepresent the evidence.

hardJudge.note: 정답 B는 두 필사본(St. Gallen 주석 → 필경사 작업 환경 / Luttrell Psalter → 14세기 농기구)을 역사가의 해석 두 개와 함께 한 문장으로 통합하고, 'Whereas'로 '서로 다른 측면'이라는 목표를 충족한다. A는 한 필사본만(체크리스트 4), D는 '자주 부족', '더 앞선 도구'라는 노트 외 과잉 일반화(체크리스트 5), C는 두 필사본을 모두 다루며 비교 구조까지 갖추었지만 제작 시기·장소라는 표면적 차원만 비교해 '생활의 측면'이라는 목표 초점을 놓친 정교한 오답으로, 목표 범위 판별(purpose_scope_calibration)을 실제로 요구한다. 사실 관계(St. Gallen 아일랜드 필사본의 'hairy parchment' 주석, Luttrell Psalter c. 1330 영국 농경 삽화)도 정확하다. 해설은 각 선지 판정과 일치하며 모순 없음.

advisory.note: C는 두 필사본을 모두 다루지만 '생활의 다른 측면'이 아니라 시기와 장소만 비교한다. D는 'often', 'prove', 'more advanced' 같은 과잉 일반화를 담고 있어 확실성 수준을 구별하게 한다. 다만 B의 문장 구조('Whereas')가 질문의 목표 문구와 거의 그대로 겹쳐 정답 식별이 다소 쉽다.

problem.passage:
Shakespeare's sonnets follow a strict pattern: fourteen lines of iambic pentameter, three quatrains, and a closing rhymed couplet. Many readers assume that this rigid frame left little room for surprise, and in a purely statistical sense they are right, since the volta, or thematic turn, falls at or near the couplet in the large majority of the poems. Literary scholar Helen Vendler argues, however, that Shakespeare used this predictable placement to set up expectations that the couplet could then complicate rather than simply resolve. ______ in Sonnet 130 the couplet does not reverse the speaker's unflattering catalog of his mistress's features so much as reframe it, insisting that honest description is itself a form of devotion.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Shakespeare's sonnets follow a strict pattern: fourteen lines of iambic pentameter, three quatrains, and a closing rhymed couplet. Many readers assume that this rigid frame left little room for surprise, and in a purely statistical sense they are right, since the volta, or thematic turn, falls at or near the couplet in the large majority of the poems. Literary scholar Helen Vendler argues, however, that Shakespeare used this predictable placement to set up expectations that the couplet could then complicate rather than simply resolve. ______ in Sonnet 130 the couplet does not reverse the speaker's unflattering catalog of his mistress's features so much as reframe it, insisting that honest description is itself a form of devotion.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
options: For instance,
As a result,
Granted,
Similarly,
problem.explanation:
지문에는 정보가 여러 개 나열된다. 소네트의 형식, 볼타가 대부분 2행 연구 근처에 온다는 통계적 사실, 그리고 Vendler의 주장(예측 가능한 위치를 이용해 결말에서 해결하기보다 복잡하게 만든다)이다. 마지막 문장은 Sonnet 130의 2행 연구가 앞의 묘사를 뒤집지 않고 재구성한다는 내용이므로, 이 중 Vendler의 주장을 보여 주는 구체적 사례에 해당한다. 따라서 예시를 나타내는 'For instance,'가 정답이다.
B(As a result,): 앞에서 말한 '볼타의 위치가 예측 가능하다'는 사실과는 표면적으로 이어지는 것처럼 보인다. 그러나 Sonnet 130의 사례는 그 주장에서 생긴 결과가 아니라 주장을 보여 주는 예이므로, 인과 관계로 연결하는 것은 맞지 않는다.
C(Granted,): 앞 내용에 대한 양보나 예외를 이끄는 표현이다. 그러나 마지막 문장은 Vendler의 주장을 뒷받침하므로 논리 관계가 다르다.
D(Similarly,): 비슷한 다른 현상을 덧붙일 때 쓰는 표현이다. 그러나 마지막 문장은 별개의 유사 사례가 아니라 바로 앞 주장 자체의 구체적인 예이므로 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn:
The text lists several pieces of information: the sonnet's form, the statistical fact that the volta usually falls at or near the couplet, and Vendler's claim that Shakespeare used this predictable placement to complicate the ending rather than resolve it. The last sentence describes Sonnet 130's couplet reframing, rather than reversing, what came before. That is a concrete illustration of Vendler's claim, so "For instance," is correct.
B ("As a result,") seems to fit the fact about the volta's predictable placement. However, the Sonnet 130 case doesn't result from Vendler's claim. It illustrates the claim, so a cause-and-effect link is wrong.
C ("Granted,") introduces a concession or exception. The final sentence supports Vendler's claim instead of conceding a point against it.
D ("Similarly,") adds a separate, parallel case. The final sentence is not a parallel case. It is a direct example of the claim just made.

hardJudge.note: 지문은 독자들의 통념(엄격한 형식→놀라움 없음), 통계적 사실(볼타가 2행 연구 근처), Vendler의 반론(예측 가능성을 이용해 결말을 '해결'이 아닌 '복잡화')이라는 세 층위를 제시하고, 마지막 문장(뒤집기보다 재구성)이 그중 Vendler의 주장을 예시함을 판별해야 한다. 'does not reverse so much as reframe'이 'complicate rather than simply resolve'와 대응함을 추적해야 하므로 단순 인접 문장 연결을 넘어선다. B는 통계적 예측 가능성과 표면적으로 이어지나 인과가 아니고, C는 방향이 반대, D는 별개 유사 사례가 아니라 예시라는 점에서 오답 설계가 타당하다. 체크리스트 3은 B가 부수 사실과 연결된다는 설명이 다소 약하지만 충족으로 봄. Sonnet 130 결말('I think my love as rare / As any she belied with false compare')을 '재구성'으로 해석한 것은 통상적 독법과 부합. 어휘(volta, quatrain)는 SAT 범위 내.

advisory.note: 정답 A는 옳다. 마지막 문장은 바로 앞 문장(however가 들어간 Vendler의 주장)을 보여 주는 직접적 사례이므로 예시 관계는 국소적으로 바로 파악된다. 따라서 전형적인 medium 수준의 예시 전환어 문항과 다를 바 없다. 체감 난이도는 주로 긴 문장과 iambic pentameter·quatrain·volta 같은 전문 어휘에서 나오므로 체크리스트 5번을 충족하지 못한다. 오답 B·C·D도 쉽게 배제되며, goal_vs_content_discrimination 같은 hard 특성의 추가 사고는 실제로 요구되지 않는다.

problem.passage:
Many landscapes by Chinese literati painters of the Song and Yuan dynasties leave more than half of the silk or paper untouched, and some early Western collectors read these bare areas as signs of hasty, casual execution. Yet the scholar-artists' own treatises describe deciding where the blank zones would fall before making a single brushstroke, and infrared imaging of several scrolls reveals faint preliminary lines marking the edges of areas meant to stay empty. ______ the unpainted expanses seem to have been planned as carefully as the mountains themselves, serving as mist and distance rather than simple absence.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Many landscapes by Chinese literati painters of the Song and Yuan dynasties leave more than half of the silk or paper untouched, and some early Western collectors read these bare areas as signs of hasty, casual execution. Yet the scholar-artists' own treatises describe deciding where the blank zones would fall before making a single brushstroke, and infrared imaging of several scrolls reveals faint preliminary lines marking the edges of areas meant to stay empty. ______ the unpainted expanses seem to have been planned as carefully as the mountains themselves, serving as mist and distance rather than simple absence.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
options: Admittedly,
Taken together,
Nevertheless,
For instance,
problem.explanation: 정답 B. 지문은 상충하는 듯한 두 관찰을 제시한다. 그림 대부분이 비어 있다는 점(대충 그린 것처럼 보임)과, 논저와 적외선 밑선이 그 빈 공간이 미리 계획되었음을 보여 준다는 점이다. 마지막 문장은 두 관찰을 종합해 '빈 공간은 의도적으로 구성된 요소'라는 결론을 내리므로, 종합을 나타내는 'Taken together,'가 알맞다. A 'Admittedly,'는 첫 번째 관찰(성의 없이 그렸다는 해석)에 대한 양보만 반영한다. 그런데 마지막 문장은 그 해석을 인정하는 것이 아니라 뒤집는다. C 'Nevertheless,'는 두 관찰이 상반된다는 점만 보고 단순 대조로 처리한 것이다. 바로 앞 문장(계획의 증거)과 결론은 같은 방향이므로 대조가 성립하지 않는다. D 'For instance,'는 예시를 도입하는 말이다. 마지막 문장은 앞 내용의 예가 아니라 결론이므로 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The answer is B. The passage gives two observations that seem to clash. First, the paintings are mostly blank, which some collectors took as a sign of careless work. Second, the painters' treatises and the infrared underdrawings show that those blank areas were planned. The last sentence combines both observations into one conclusion: the emptiness was deliberately composed. "Taken together," signals exactly that kind of synthesis. A ("Admittedly,") only concedes the first observation, the "hasty execution" reading, but the final sentence overturns that reading instead of granting it. C ("Nevertheless,") treats the two observations as a simple contrast. However, the sentence right before the blank (the evidence of planning) points the same way as the conclusion, so there is nothing to contrast. D ("For instance,") introduces an example, but the final sentence is a conclusion, not an example of what came before.

hardJudge.note: 지문 구조: 관찰1(빈 공간→성의 없음으로 해석) vs 관찰2(논저+적외선 밑선→사전 계획). 'Yet'이 이미 대조를 처리했으므로 마지막 문장은 논저·적외선 증거를 종합한 결론이며 'Taken together'가 정확. C 'Nevertheless'는 직전 문장과 결론이 같은 방향이라 대조 불성립(단순 대조 오답), A 'Admittedly'는 첫 관찰에 대한 양보만 반영(한쪽 관찰 오답), D는 예시 아님. 해설의 오답 분석도 논리적으로 정확. 다만 '종합'의 대상이 엄밀히는 상충하는 두 관찰이 아니라 2문장의 두 증거(논저+이미징)라는 점에서 체크리스트 2는 넓게 해석하여 충족으로 판정. 'Yet'이 이미 대조를 소화했음을 파악해야 C를 배제할 수 있어 medium 이상의 추론 요구.

advisory.note: 정답 B는 맞다. 앞 문장의 'Yet' 때문에 C 'Nevertheless'로 끌리기 쉽다. 정답을 고르려면 두 가지 증거(논저, 적외선 밑선)를 종합해 첫 해석을 반박하는 방향을 추론해야 한다. 다만 'Taken together' 유형 자체는 흔해서 hard 수준으로는 경계선에 있다.

problem.passage:
The Implicit Association Test (IAT) asks participants to sort faces and words as quickly as possible, and in one version Black and White faces share response keys with positive or negative words. Across thousands of participants, responses are reliably slower when the key pairings run counter to widespread racial stereotypes. Many researchers see this pattern as evidence that stereotypes can be activated automatically, before a person consciously reflects. ______ when the same individual takes the test twice a few weeks apart, the two scores often differ substantially, which limits how much any single score can reveal about that particular person.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: The Implicit Association Test (IAT) asks participants to sort faces and words as quickly as possible, and in one version Black and White faces share response keys with positive or negative words. Across thousands of participants, responses are reliably slower when the key pairings run counter to widespread racial stereotypes. Many researchers see this pattern as evidence that stereotypes can be activated automatically, before a person consciously reflects. ______ when the same individual takes the test twice a few weeks apart, the two scores often differ substantially, which limits how much any single score can reveal about that particular person.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
options: Specifically,
Even so,
In addition,
As a result,
problem.explanation: 앞 문장들은 집단 수준에서 IAT 결과가 안정적이며 자동적 고정관념 활성화의 증거로 여겨진다고 말하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 개인 점수가 반복 측정에서 크게 달라 개인에 대해서는 알려주는 것이 제한적이라고 한다. 따라서 앞의 강점을 인정한 뒤 한계를 제시하는 양보·반전 관계이므로 B가 정답이다. A는 뒤 문장을 앞 내용의 구체적 세부로 보지만, 개인 점수의 불안정성은 집단 결과를 구체화하는 것이 아니라 그 결과와 긴장 관계에 있다. C는 둘 다 IAT에 대한 사실이라는 점에서 그럴듯하지만, 뒤 문장은 같은 방향의 증거를 덧붙이는 것이 아니라 반대 방향의 한계를 말한다. D는 집단 결과가 안정적이라는 사실이 개인 점수의 불안정성을 낳는 원인이 아니므로 인과 관계가 성립하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The earlier sentences say the IAT produces a reliable pattern across large groups and is treated as evidence that stereotypes activate automatically. The sentence after the blank says an individual's scores can change a lot from one test to the next, which limits what a single score tells us. That is a concession followed by a contrast, so B is correct. A doesn't work because the unstable individual scores don't give a specific detail of the group finding. Instead, they push against it. C is tempting because both sentences describe the IAT, but the second one points out a limitation rather than adding support in the same direction. D is wrong because reliable group results don't cause individual scores to be unstable, so there's no cause-and-effect link.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(집단 수준에서 안정적·자동 활성화 증거) 대 뒤 문장(개인 점수 불안정·개인 추론 제한)의 양보-반전 관계를 직접 검산한 결과 B "Even so"가 유일하게 논리적임. A·C는 '둘 다 IAT 관련 사실'이라는 부분적 근거로 비교가 필요하고 D도 표면상 말이 됨. IAT의 낮은 검사-재검사 신뢰도는 실제 연구 결과와 부합. 한·영 해설 결론·글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음.

advisory.note: 집단 수준의 안정성과 개인 수준의 낮은 재검사 신뢰도를 대비시키는 문항으로, IAT 연구 결과에 부합함. 오답 C(둘 다 IAT 관련)와 A(구체화)는 그럴듯해서 비교해야 배제됨. 빈칸 뒤 문장에 'when' 절이 있어 대비 관계를 알아차리려면 정독이 필요함. 중간 난이도에 적합.

problem.passage:
In 1968, psychologist Robert Rosenthal and school principal Lenore Jacobson reported the results of a study at an elementary school in California. At the start of the school year, students took a test that the researchers described to teachers as a measure of who was likely to "bloom" intellectually. The researchers then told teachers which students had scored as likely bloomers. In fact, those students had been chosen at random and did not differ from their classmates. When the students were tested again months later, the randomly labeled children, especially those in the earliest grades, showed larger gains in IQ scores than their peers did. Rosenthal and Jacobson concluded that the teachers' beliefs about the students had somehow translated into real differences in how much the students improved.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
problem.stimulus: In 1968, psychologist Robert Rosenthal and school principal Lenore Jacobson reported the results of a study at an elementary school in California. At the start of the school year, students took a test that the researchers described to teachers as a measure of who was likely to "bloom" intellectually. The researchers then told teachers which students had scored as likely bloomers. In fact, those students had been chosen at random and did not differ from their classmates. When the students were tested again months later, the randomly labeled children, especially those in the earliest grades, showed larger gains in IQ scores than their peers did. Rosenthal and Jacobson concluded that the teachers' beliefs about the students had somehow translated into real differences in how much the students improved.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: A 1968 study found that a test given at the start of the school year could accurately identify which young students would make the largest intellectual gains.
A 1968 study found that students in the earliest grades improved more on IQ tests over a school year than did students in later grades.
A 1968 study found that what teachers were led to believe about certain students appeared to shape how much those students' test performance improved.
A 1968 study found that teachers at an elementary school were often unable to tell which of their students had scored highest on an intelligence test.
problem.explanation: 지문의 핵심은 무작위로 뽑힌 학생들이 '성장할 학생'으로 소개되었고, 그 학생들이 더 큰 IQ 향상을 보였으며, 연구자들이 이를 교사의 믿음이 낳은 결과로 결론지었다는 것이다. 따라서 C가 정답이다. A는 시험이 실제로 성장을 예측했다고 하지만, 지문에서 학생들은 무작위로 선정되었으므로 시험이 예측한 것이 아니다. B는 낮은 학년이 더 큰 향상을 보였다는 세부 내용을 왜곡한 것인데, 지문은 학년 간 비교가 아니라 무작위로 지목된 학생과 또래의 비교를 다루며, 낮은 학년 언급은 부수적인 세부일 뿐이다. D는 교사가 고득점자를 알아보지 못했다고 하지만, 지문은 그런 능력을 다루지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The text explains that randomly chosen students were presented to teachers as likely "bloomers," that those students later showed bigger IQ gains, and that the researchers credited the teachers' beliefs for this. That makes C correct. A says the test really predicted growth, but the students were picked at random, so the test predicted nothing. B distorts a detail: the text compares the labeled students with their peers, not younger grades with older grades, and the mention of the earliest grades is only a side detail. D claims teachers couldn't tell who scored highest, but the text never looks at that ability.

hardJudge.note: 지문은 Rosenthal & Jacobson(1968) 'Pygmalion in the Classroom' 연구를 정확히 요약(캘리포니아 초등학교, 무작위 지목, 저학년에서 효과 큼). 정답 C는 결론 문장과 직접 대응. A는 '시험이 예측'이라는 훑어 읽기 함정(무작위 선정으로 배제), B는 저학년 세부를 주제로 격상한 오답, D는 지문에 근거 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 C를 일관되게 뒷받침하고 선택지 참조 정확. 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 난이도 medium 적합.

advisory.note: Pygmalion 연구(Oak School, 1968) 사실관계 정확함. A는 '시험'과 '향상'이라는 표면 근거로, B는 지문 속 저학년 세부를 근거로 오답을 유도하므로 비교 판단이 필요함. D는 비교적 쉽게 배제되지만 그럴듯함. 중간 난이도에 맞되 쉬운 쪽에 가까움.

problem.passage:
In 1973, psychologist David Rosenhan published a study in which eight mentally healthy volunteers sought admission to psychiatric hospitals by claiming to hear voices. Once admitted, they stopped reporting any symptoms and behaved normally, yet staff kept them for an average of nineteen days, and nearly all were discharged with a diagnosis of schizophrenia "in remission." Rosenhan argued that the hospital setting itself shaped how staff read behavior: one pseudopatient's habit of taking notes, for instance, was recorded in his chart as "engaging in writing behavior." __Notably, several actual patients on the wards voiced suspicions that the volunteers were journalists or researchers rather than people who were ill.__ For Rosenhan, this contrast suggested that the difficulty lay less in the volunteers' behavior than in the expectations that came with an institutional label.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
problem.stimulus: In 1973, psychologist David Rosenhan published a study in which eight mentally healthy volunteers sought admission to psychiatric hospitals by claiming to hear voices. Once admitted, they stopped reporting any symptoms and behaved normally, yet staff kept them for an average of nineteen days, and nearly all were discharged with a diagnosis of schizophrenia "in remission." Rosenhan argued that the hospital setting itself shaped how staff read behavior: one pseudopatient's habit of taking notes, for instance, was recorded in his chart as "engaging in writing behavior." __Notably, several actual patients on the wards voiced suspicions that the volunteers were journalists or researchers rather than people who were ill.__ For Rosenhan, this contrast suggested that the difficulty lay less in the volunteers' behavior than in the expectations that came with an institutional label.
problem.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It presents evidence that the pseudopatients behaved in ways that made their real purpose obvious to hospital staff.
It offers an example of how the hospital setting led staff to misread an ordinary activity as a sign of illness.
It provides an observation that helps support the claim that staff judgments were driven by the label rather than by the volunteers' conduct.
It raises a doubt about whether the volunteers successfully kept up their pretense after being admitted to the hospitals.
problem.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 실제 환자들은 자원자들이 정상임을 알아챘다는 관찰을 제시하고, 마지막 문장이 이 '대조'를 근거로 문제는 행동이 아니라 기관의 낙인에 따른 기대에 있다고 결론짓는다. 따라서 C가 정답이다. A는 자원자의 정체를 알아챈 것이 직원이 아니라 환자였으므로 틀렸다. B는 앞 문장(필기를 '쓰기 행동'으로 기록)의 기능이지 밑줄 문장의 기능이 아니다. D는 자원자들이 정상적으로 행동했다는 지문 내용과 맞지 않으며, 밑줄 문장은 연기의 실패를 의심하는 것이 아니라 낙인 효과를 뒷받침한다.
problem.explanationEn: The underlined sentence reports that real patients saw the volunteers as healthy, and the final sentence uses this "contrast" to conclude that the problem was the expectations attached to an institutional label, not the volunteers' behavior. That makes C correct. A is wrong because it was patients, not staff, who suspected the volunteers' real purpose. B describes the function of the previous sentence (note-taking recorded as "writing behavior"), not the underlined one.
